script.title: Finding One
script.synopsis: At a bus stop the Inspector formally cites a single ticket stub four centimetres from the bin while the city ignores her, bins it with ceremony, and walks away trailing a ribbon of identical stubs from her own pockets.

beats.beat: Locked frame shows silhouette, lamp and the stub; one two-finger tap
She states the finding to indifferent passers-by
Louder verdict, bins and logs the stub
Ribbon of stubs spills from her pockets as she exits
Held beat on the trail she does not see

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.line: A stub. Four centimetres from the bin.

script.caption_text: Finding one. A stub. Four centimetres from the bin. Litter. Noted. Filed.

scenes.location: Bus stop with a timetable board (recurring bible location)
scenes.action: Frame one: the Inspector stands centre-left beside the blank timetable board, lamp lit on her chest, facing a single ticket stub on the pavement four centimetres from the steel bin. A blurred passer-by crosses behind. After one beat she gives one slow two-finger tap on the clipboard, then speaks.
scenes.performance: Invested task: formally open a finding; goal is to get the stub on record, obstacle is the crowd walking through frame, tactic is stillness and procedure. Eyes stay on the stub, then lift to the passing blur.
scenes.microexpression: Brows level; a faint settle of the glasses down the nose as she looks at the stub.

dialogue.speaker: Inspector
dialogue.delivery: measured, bureaucratic, normal volume, aimed at passers-by
